final: WITH account_avg AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_amount FROM account_avg GROUP BY region), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_amount FROM region_avg) SELECT r.region, r.avg_amount, r.avg_amount - o.avg_amount AS difference, 1.0 * r.avg_amount / NULLIF(o.avg_amount, 0) AS ratio FROM region_avg AS r CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o WHERE o.avg_amount IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_amount > o.avg_amount
